title: Popeye the Sailor
description: Follows the adventures of the famed spinach-eating sailor man.Popeye is one of the most popular cartoon characters of all time. This spunky but loveable spinach-eating sailor continues to delight young and old with his comic adventures, and the entire gang is around to provide plenty of rousing fun and action: Olive Oyl, Swee’Pea, Wimpy and Bluto.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Popeye wants to have a backyard barbecue with Olive Oyl, but is continually interrupted by a scheming Brutus, a hungry Wimpy and a crying Sweet Pea.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Popeye, Olive and Wimpy end up on the moon with little cheese men. They meet some moon men who introduce the trio to their leader, "Big Cheese." Popeye asks for help in getting back to Earth, but the leader is an evil man and tries to imprison Popeye and his friends. However, the moon men have taken a liking to Popeye and don't like the way that their leader has treated him, so they help him escape by overthrowing "Big Cheese."

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Olive watch Brutus the strongman performing at the carnival. The two men quickly become rivals for Olive. But she makes Popeye promise not to fight.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Popeye in his junk-pile jalopy competes with Brutus in his slick race car to win a cross-country race. Brutus employs a series of dirty tricks to keep ahead, while keeping Olive Oyl trapped in his trunk.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Sheriff Popeye captures villain Brutus McBride and throws the scum into jail. His gang of thugs start a big shoot-out in an attempt to free their leader.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Olive take shelter from a thunderstorm in Mad Mueller's castle. But Mueller's monster, Irving, takes a shine to Olive.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Popeye tells Olive the story of how his ancestor Prehesterical Popeye discovered the magical powers of spinach and stopped Prehesterical Brutus.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Popeye objects to how a bull is being treated by the matador in the bullring, then when Olive Is caught in the Bull, between the matador and the bull, he must use spinach to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Flying saucers have landed, Olive is unfortunate enough to be captured by a robot man looking for humans. Popeye must take control of the spaceship save Olive and get her home.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Olive the college student is infatuated with Professor Brutus and contemptuous of Popeye's lack of education, leading Popeye to enroll in college himself.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Popeye hears talk of abominable snowman sightings and so decides to take it upon himself to investigate.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: It's an ice cold winter, Popeye upsets a large hibernating bear while trying to impress Olive with his moves on the ski-jumps.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Olive are out testing Popeyes new boat on a relaxing boat ride. When out in the ocean they meet Jolly Roger the pirate. Unfortunately Roger takes a fancy to Olive. The pirate kidnaps her and sets school of sharks after Popeye.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Olive are searching the jungle for the rare Foola-Foola bird. Following close behind is Brutus, also hunting the bird as there is a reward of a million dollar for finding it.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Olive set-sail to a desert island with a map citing the location of Uranium, unknown to them Brutus is already there, He plans on dressing like a gorilla and scaring them away.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Brutus dresses as a native Indian and claims the land as an Indian Reservation after Popeye strikes it lucky searching for gold in the old west. Popeye tries to beat him at his own game by dressing as an Indian too, declaring all out war.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Brutus forces Popeye into the professor's aging machine, turning him into a 2 year old.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Popeye volunteers to stand guard to protect Poopdeck Pappy's ranch, a rustler tries to get rid of Popeye but is driven mad by his ability to reappear right after he's been lassoed, tied up and even thrown off a cliff.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Olive sees Brutus showing his athletic prowess at a track meet, Popeye gets jealous, runs on to the field and starts competing himself.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Wimpy has acquired the SeaHags crystal ball, he is using it to bet on sporting events. Brutus realizes this and steal the crystal ball. Popeye gets suspicious, so sets a trap to get the ball back.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Brutus sinks to a new low in both greed and criminal activity by trying to abduct little Swee'pee from his family.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: As Popeye and Olive relax on their new boat "The Miss Olive" someone swims beneath stealing items from right under their nose. Luckily Brutus's boating store has a seemingly endless supply of stolen item replacements.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: A giant space magnet connected to the top of an astronomer's observatory pulls stuff from outer space to earth. One day it also pulls leather jacket wearing space greasers from Mars.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Popeye is jailed for committing a bank robbery which he insists he didn't commit. He must prove he didn't do it. In a seemingly unrelated subplot, two thugs build a Popeye robot to do their bidding.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The citizens are revolting, they want a new king, someone sweet like Swee'pea! Professor Wotasnozzle suggests making a soup out of Swee'pea is the best way to become just like him.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Popeye, Olive, Wimpy, and Swee' Pea, set-sail to The Sea Hag's island, She has kidnapped Eugene, the Jeep. Unknown to them The Sea Hag is following in her submarine waiting for an opportunity to remove all spinach from Popeye's boat.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: The Professor, Popeye and their assistant Brutus are searching for the lost city of "Bubble-On". Popeye is suspicious, he thinks Brutus is more interested in taking the cities treasure than documenting scientific discoveries.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Brutus beats up an alien he sees walking down the street, thinking its Popeye on the way to Olive Oyl's fancy dress party. The alien retaliates by trying to blow up the earth, Popeye and Brutus team up to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Someone has sent Popeye a present, he opens it to find shaving lotion, thinking it's something Olive Oyl has bought for him he puts it on. From that moment everyone hates him.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Popeye is undergoing a series of government tests, one of which involves using spinach to travel in a rocket at the speed of light. Meanwhile at home Brutus moves in on Olive.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Popeye is called by a lawyer who tells him that he and Brutus are the beneficiaries of someone they know. And that he'll be reading the will at noon. And if one of them is not there at noon they will forfeit the inheritance. So Brutus tries to keep Popeye from getting there at noon.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Popeye and Brutus are rival artists, each of whom wants to win a magazine contest for the best original flower painting.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: Olive is a sculptor and puts an ad in a shop window asking for a model. Popeye and Brutus both offer their services. Olive tells them she's not looking for someone who is strong and healthy but someone who is worn and tired. So both Popeye and Brutus try to mess themselves up but one of them always stops the other.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Popeye is showing off his stage act, a flea circus, Brutus is tired of hearing the rave reviews about it so destroys the act by setting a dog loose on stage.

episodes_data.title: Popeye the Sailor Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Olive insists that Popeye babysit her Niece while she goes out, Popeye hasn't slept for 6 days and begins to fall asleep on the job, he gets put in a dress and Olive takes offence thinking he's making fun of her.
